title: 第17章 造化虚空诡诀第18章 虚空传送令
slug: 青铜古舟第802章你惹上事了
content_zh:
“我就知道……”
沈算看着这诡异阴森的景象，忍不住喃喃自语，“这造化出来的神卫肯定邪门，可没想到，阵仗会这么邪门！”
话音未落之际，一道破开大殿无边黑暗的淡黄色光芒，毫无征兆地激射而出，快如闪电，精准无比地击中沈算的眉心！
“呃！”
沈算只觉脑颅如遭重锤，嗡鸣之声瞬间炸响！
眼前一黑，意识仿佛被强行拖拽，无数破碎的画面如同失控的幻灯片，在他脑海中疯狂闪现、轮转：
画面一：懵懂孩童跟随父亲跋涉行商。
烈日风霜，道路崎岖。
他亲眼目睹市井百姓的锱铢必较，遭遇山林土匪的狰狞凶残。
父亲在强权前的卑微讨好，在刀光剑影中为护他而爆发的决死反抗……鲜血喷溅，生死只在毫厘之间！
画面二：山间简陋的宿营地篝火旁。
一个沉默的少年背对众人，如获至宝般捧着一卷残破的经书，封皮上是三个古朴大字——《红尘诀》。
微弱的火光映照着他专注的侧脸，口中无声默念：“采红尘万丈气，证吾道，成就不朽红尘仙……”
画面三：昏暗幽闭的地下密室。
一个面容沧桑的中年人，捧着那半卷《红尘诀》，指尖因用力而发白，眼中闪烁着不甘与疯狂的光芒，低声嘶语：“道途已断……但气运犹存……前路断绝，何不自开新天？！”
画面四：奢华宏伟与仙气缭绕隔隔不入的花园凉亭中。
一位宛如富家翁的老者安坐其中，指尖缠绕着一缕缕精纯、灵动、变幻莫测的……红尘之气！
他低眉垂目，凝视指尖气息，陷入长久的沉思。
某刻，他眼中决然之色一闪！
画面五：老者身影如鬼魅般消失，再次出现时，已身处一座阴森古老的大墓深处！

他双眸平静无波，目光扫过墓穴中陪葬的青铜古器。
下一刻，他做出了一个惊世骇俗、为世人所不齿的决定——盗墓！
只为盗取青铜炼器！
从此一发不可收拾，踏上了这条离经叛道之路……
画面六：画面陡然拔高，切换至浩瀚无垠的冰冷虚空！
一艘庞大的青铜古船，正破开死寂的星海，孤独地驶向未知的彼岸。
船体斑驳，刻满岁月的痕迹。
画面七：视角拉近，进入古船最核心的青铜大殿。
殿中，一位白发苍苍的老者盘膝而坐，正是那富家翁！
此刻他眉宇紧锁，面容因巨大的痛苦而扭曲，周身被浓稠如墨、散发着极致不祥与疯狂的诡异黑气死死缠绕、侵蚀！
画面八：老者发出一声悠长而疲惫的叹息，声音在死寂的大殿中回荡：“罢了……罢了……老夫本一介行商俗子，能走到今日，已是逆天而行……又有何不甘？就让我……与你……同葬此舟……共化虚无吧……”
呓语声落，老者身躯骤然爆发出刺目光芒，整个人竟化作一尊巨大的虚空熔炉！
他要以自身为薪柴，祭炼己身，连同这诡异邪恶的黑气，一同湮灭！
当真是个狠人！
画面九：虚空熔炉轰然破碎！
磅礴的灰白色雾气汹涌升腾，瞬间弥漫包裹住整艘巨大的青铜古舟。
而那狂暴的诡异黑气，如同被激怒的凶兽，自破损的大殿中疯狂喷涌而出，在古船内部横冲直撞，却无论如何也无法冲破那层看似稀薄、实则坚韧无比的灰白雾气屏障……
content_en:
"I knew..."
Shen Suan looked at this strange and gloomy scene and couldn't help but murmur to himself, "This created divine guard must be evil, but I didn't expect that the formation would be so evil!"
Before he finished speaking, a ray of light yellow light broke through the boundless darkness of the hall and shot out without warning. It was as fast as lightning and hit Shen Suan between the eyebrows with incomparable precision!
"Ugh!"
Shen Suan felt as if his head had been hit hard, and a buzzing sound exploded instantly!
His vision went dark, and his consciousness seemed to be forcibly dragged. Countless broken images were like out-of-control slides, flashing and rotating crazily in his mind:
Picture 1: An ignorant child follows his father on a business trip.
The road is rugged due to the scorching sun, wind and frost.
He witnessed with his own eyes how ordinary people in the city were spending money and money, and encountered the brutality of bandits in the mountains and forests.
His father's humble flattery in front of the powerful, his desperate resistance to protect him amidst the flash of swords and swords... Blood spurts, life and death are only a matter of millimeters!
Picture 2: Beside a bonfire at a simple camping site in the mountains.
A silent young man turned his back to everyone, holding a broken scroll of scripture as if he had found a treasure. On the cover were three simple characters - "The Secret of the Red Dust".
The weak firelight illuminated his focused side face, and he muttered silently: "Collect the energy of the world of mortals, prove my way, and become an immortal immortal of the mortal world..."
Picture 3: A dark and claustrophobic underground chamber.
A middle-aged man with a vicissitudes of face was holding the half volume of "The Secret of the Red Dust", his fingertips turned white from exertion, his eyes flashed with unwillingness and madness, and hissed in a low voice: "The road has been cut off...but the luck is still there...the road ahead is cut off, why not create a new world?!"
Picture 4: In an inaccessible garden pavilion filled with luxury, grandeur and fairy spirit.
An old man who looks like a rich man is sitting in it, with wisps of pure, smart, unpredictable... worldly aura wrapped around his fingertips!
He lowered his eyebrows and stared at the breath on his fingertips, falling into deep thought for a long time.
At a certain moment, a look of determination flashed in his eyes!
Screen 5: The old man disappeared like a ghost, and when he reappeared, he was deep in a gloomy and ancient tomb!
His eyes were calm as he glanced at the ancient bronze vessels buried in the tomb.
The next moment, he made a shocking and despised decision - to rob a tomb!
Just to steal the bronze weapon!
From then on, I got out of hand and embarked on this deviant road...
Screen 6: The screen suddenly rises and switches to the vast, icy void!
A huge ancient bronze ship is breaking through the dead sea of ​​stars and sailing alone to the unknown shore.
The hull is mottled and full of traces of time.
Screen 7: The perspective is zoomed in, entering the bronze hall at the core of the ancient ship.
In the hall, a white-haired old man sat cross-legged, it was the rich man!
At this moment, his brows were furrowed, his face was distorted by the tremendous pain, and his whole body was entangled and eroded by the strange black energy that was as thick as ink and exuded extreme ominousness and madness!
Screen 8: The old man let out a long and tired sigh, and his voice echoed in the deathly silence of the hall: "That's it...that's all... I am a businessman, and to be able to reach this day has gone against the will of heaven... What's the point of not being willing to accept it? Let me... be buried in this boat with you... and disappear into nothingness..."
As his words fell, the old man's body suddenly erupted with dazzling light, and his whole body turned into a huge void furnace!
He will use himself as firewood, sacrifice his body, and annihilate it together with this weird and evil black energy!
What a ruthless person!
Screen 9: The void furnace shatters!
The majestic gray-white mist rose violently and instantly filled and enveloped the entire huge ancient bronze boat.
And the violent and strange black energy, like an enraged ferocious beast, spewed out crazily from the damaged hall and ran rampant inside the ancient ship, but it could not break through the seemingly thin but actually extremely tough gray-white mist barrier...
